acceptance.scope: Full report, all issues, explanations, repairs and retained correct information; no keyword-only scoring.
acceptance.category: Accept schema-valid, semantically coherent classifications; no preferred enum requirement.
acceptance.reference: Synthetic reviews below demonstrate local feasibility only. Different faithful repairs are allowed; exact reference matching is NOT an evaluation gate.
acceptance.score: Use existing pass>=85 gate; revision score/verdict must be consistent. Synthetic scores are examples, not exact targets.
acceptance.unexpected_finding: Check full sources. A new real error invalidates the clean-control premise; stop design, never force its prior label.
acceptance.mixed_output: Protocol failure, not evidence of zero tool candidates or semantic quality.
acceptance.opinion_pair: Actual non-overlapping repairs only; identical overlapping edits still conflict. No invented pass to complete a missing duty.
acceptance.disposition: All six supported: eligible for considering further bounded evidence, not model adoption or qualification. Semantic failure: close current configuration screen; protocol/material uncertainty: no semantic verdict, close and preserve evidence.
